Disclaimer

Last updated: 6 August 2026

No guaranteed outcomes

Disha Consultancy Services provides guidance, information and counselling. We do not guarantee admission to any institution, allotment of any seat, any examination rank or score, any scholarship, any visa, any job offer or any level of income. Any statement on this website should be read in that light.

No affiliation

We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an agent of the National Testing Agency, the Medical Counselling Committee, JoSAA, CSAB, any state counselling authority, any university, college, coaching institute, employer or government department. Names of examinations and institutions are used only to describe the services we provide.

Information may change

Cutoffs, eligibility rules, fee structures, deadlines and government policies change, sometimes mid-season. Everything on this website is provided in good faith and to the best of our knowledge on the date shown, but you must verify all specifics against the official notification before acting. We accept no liability for decisions taken on the basis of outdated or superseded information.

Not professional advice in regulated fields

Nothing here constitutes legal, medical, psychiatric, clinical psychological, financial-investment, taxation or immigration advice. Our coaching services are non-clinical: we do not diagnose or treat any condition. Where your situation calls for a licensed professional, we will tell you and, where we can, point you to one.

Mental health

If you are in distress or thinking about harming yourself, please seek help immediately. In India, Tele-MANAS (Government of India) is available 24×7 on 14416 or 1-800-891-4416. In an emergency, call 112. Please do not wait for a scheduled session.

Testimonials and examples

Testimonials describe individual experiences and are published with consent. They are not a promise that you will experience the same result. Case examples may be anonymised or combined to protect client privacy.

Third-party links

Links to official portals and other websites are provided for convenience only. We do not control their content and are not responsible for their accuracy, availability or privacy practices.

Fraud warning

We will never ask for your examination portal password or OTP, never ask you to pay a college or "management quota" fee through us, and never ask for payment to a personal bank account. If someone contacts you claiming to be us and does any of these things, it is not us — please report it to support@example.com.
